                          │                                                                  │
                          │  → l space pgdn      next step / slide                           │
                          │  ← h pgup            previous                                    │
                          │  ] [                 next / previous slide (skip steps)          │
                          │  g G                 first / last slide                          │
                          │  12g  12⏎            jump to slide 12                            │
                          │  r                   replay this slide                           │
                          │  b .                 black screen (again to resume)              │
                          │  w ,                 white screen (again to resume)              │
                          │  t  T                start or pause the timer / reset it         │
                          │  P                   post the talk as you give it                │
                          │  q                   quit (twice while posts wait to send)       │
                          ╰─ ? or esc closes · deck keys still work ─────────────────────────╯

  │􎻮̿̅􎻮̿̍􎻮̿̎􎻮̿̐􎻮̿̒􎻮̿̽􎻮̿̾􎻮̿̿􎻮̿͆􎻮̿͊􎻮̿͋􎻮̿͌􎻮̿͐􎻮̿͑􎻮̿͒􎻮̿͗􎻮̿͛􎻮̿ͣ􎻮̿ͤ􎻮̿ͥ􎻮̿ͦ􎻮̿ͧ􎻮̿ͨ􎻮̿ͩ􎻮̿ͪ􎻮̿ͫ􎻮̿ͬ􎻮̿ͭ􎻮̿ͮ􎻮̿ͯ􎻮̿҃􎻮̿҄􎻮̿҅􎻮̿҆􎻮̿҇􎻮̿֒􎻮̿֓􎻮̿֔􎻮̿֕􎻮̿֗􎻮̿֘􎻮̿֙􎻮̿֜􎻮̿֝􎻮̿֞􎻮̿֟􎻮̿֠􎻮̿֡􎻮̿֨􎻮̿֩􎻮̿֫􎻮̿֬􎻮̿֯􎻮̿ׄ│   │􎻮̿̅􎻮̿̍􎻮̿̎􎻮̿̐􎻮̿̒􎻮̿̽􎻮̿̾􎻮̿̿􎻮̿͆􎻮̿͊􎻮̿͋􎻮̿͌􎻮̿͐􎻮̿͑􎻮̿͒􎻮̿͗􎻮̿͛􎻮̿ͣ􎻮̿ͤ􎻮̿ͥ􎻮̿ͦ􎻮̿ͧ􎻮̿ͨ􎻮̿ͩ􎻮̿ͪ􎻮̿ͫ􎻮̿ͬ􎻮̿ͭ􎻮̿ͮ􎻮̿ͯ􎻮̿҃􎻮̿҄􎻮̿҅􎻮̿҆􎻮̿҇􎻮̿֒􎻮̿֓􎻮̿֔􎻮̿֕􎻮̿֗􎻮̿֘􎻮̿֙􎻮̿֜􎻮̿֝􎻮̿֞􎻮̿֟􎻮̿֠􎻮̿֡􎻮̿֨􎻮̿֩􎻮̿֫􎻮̿֬􎻮̿֯􎻮̿ׄ│
  │􎻮͆̅􎻮͆̍􎻮͆̎􎻮͆̐􎻮͆̒􎻮͆̽􎻮͆̾􎻮͆̿􎻮͆͆􎻮͆͊􎻮͆͋􎻮͆͌􎻮͆͐􎻮͆͑􎻮͆͒􎻮͆͗􎻮͆͛􎻮͆ͣ􎻮͆ͤ􎻮͆ͥ􎻮͆ͦ􎻮͆ͧ􎻮͆ͨ􎻮͆ͩ􎻮͆ͪ􎻮͆ͫ􎻮͆ͬ􎻮͆ͭ􎻮͆ͮ􎻮͆ͯ􎻮͆҃􎻮͆҄􎻮͆҅􎻮͆҆􎻮͆҇􎻮͆֒􎻮͆֓􎻮͆֔􎻮͆֕􎻮͆֗􎻮͆֘􎻮͆֙􎻮͆֜􎻮͆֝􎻮͆֞􎻮͆֟􎻮͆֠􎻮͆֡􎻮͆֨􎻮͆֩􎻮͆֫􎻮͆֬􎻮͆֯􎻮͆ׄ│   │􎻮͆̅􎻮͆̍􎻮͆̎􎻮͆̐􎻮͆̒􎻮͆̽􎻮͆̾􎻮͆̿􎻮͆͆􎻮͆͊􎻮͆͋􎻮͆͌􎻮͆͐􎻮͆͑􎻮͆͒􎻮͆͗􎻮͆͛􎻮͆ͣ􎻮͆ͤ􎻮͆ͥ􎻮͆ͦ􎻮͆ͧ􎻮͆ͨ􎻮͆ͩ􎻮͆ͪ􎻮͆ͫ􎻮͆ͬ􎻮͆ͭ􎻮͆ͮ􎻮͆ͯ􎻮͆҃􎻮͆҄􎻮͆҅􎻮͆҆􎻮͆҇􎻮͆֒􎻮͆֓􎻮͆֔􎻮͆֕􎻮͆֗􎻮͆֘􎻮͆֙􎻮͆֜􎻮͆֝􎻮͆֞􎻮͆֟􎻮͆֠􎻮͆֡􎻮͆֨􎻮͆֩􎻮͆֫􎻮͆֬􎻮͆֯􎻮͆ׄ│
  │􎻮͊̅􎻮͊̍􎻮͊̎􎻮͊̐􎻮͊̒􎻮͊̽􎻮͊̾􎻮͊̿􎻮͊͆􎻮͊͊􎻮͊͋􎻮͊͌􎻮͊͐􎻮͊͑􎻮͊͒􎻮͊͗􎻮͊͛􎻮͊ͣ􎻮͊ͤ􎻮͊ͥ􎻮͊ͦ􎻮͊ͧ􎻮͊ͨ􎻮͊ͩ􎻮͊ͪ􎻮͊ͫ􎻮͊ͬ􎻮͊ͭ􎻮͊ͮ􎻮͊ͯ􎻮͊҃􎻮͊҄􎻮͊҅􎻮͊҆􎻮͊҇􎻮͊֒􎻮͊֓􎻮͊֔􎻮͊֕􎻮͊֗􎻮͊֘􎻮͊֙􎻮͊֜􎻮͊֝􎻮͊֞􎻮͊֟􎻮͊֠􎻮͊֡􎻮͊֨􎻮͊֩􎻮͊֫􎻮͊֬􎻮͊֯􎻮͊ׄ│   │􎻮͊̅􎻮͊̍􎻮͊̎􎻮͊̐􎻮͊̒􎻮͊̽􎻮͊̾􎻮͊̿􎻮͊͆􎻮͊͊􎻮͊͋􎻮͊͌􎻮͊͐􎻮͊͑􎻮͊͒􎻮͊͗􎻮͊͛􎻮͊ͣ􎻮͊ͤ􎻮͊ͥ􎻮͊ͦ􎻮͊ͧ􎻮͊ͨ􎻮͊ͩ􎻮͊ͪ􎻮͊ͫ􎻮͊ͬ􎻮͊ͭ􎻮͊ͮ􎻮͊ͯ􎻮͊҃􎻮͊҄􎻮͊҅􎻮͊҆􎻮͊҇􎻮͊֒􎻮͊֓􎻮͊֔􎻮͊֕􎻮͊֗􎻮͊֘􎻮͊֙􎻮͊֜􎻮͊֝􎻮͊֞􎻮͊֟􎻮͊֠􎻮͊֡􎻮͊֨􎻮͊֩􎻮͊֫􎻮͊֬􎻮͊֯􎻮͊ׄ│
  │􎻮͋̅􎻮͋̍􎻮͋̎􎻮͋̐􎻮͋̒􎻮͋̽􎻮͋̾􎻮͋̿􎻮͋͆􎻮͋͊􎻮͋͋􎻮͋͌􎻮͋͐􎻮͋͑􎻮͋͒􎻮͋͗􎻮͋͛􎻮͋ͣ􎻮͋ͤ􎻮͋ͥ􎻮͋ͦ􎻮͋ͧ􎻮͋ͨ􎻮͋ͩ􎻮͋ͪ􎻮͋ͫ􎻮͋ͬ􎻮͋ͭ􎻮͋ͮ􎻮͋ͯ􎻮͋҃􎻮͋҄􎻮͋҅􎻮͋҆􎻮͋҇􎻮͋֒􎻮͋֓􎻮͋֔􎻮͋֕􎻮͋֗􎻮͋֘􎻮͋֙􎻮͋֜􎻮͋֝􎻮͋֞􎻮͋֟􎻮͋֠􎻮͋֡􎻮͋֨􎻮͋֩􎻮͋֫􎻮͋֬􎻮͋֯􎻮͋ׄ│   │􎻮͋̅􎻮͋̍􎻮͋̎􎻮͋̐􎻮͋̒􎻮͋̽􎻮͋̾􎻮͋̿􎻮͋͆􎻮͋͊􎻮͋͋􎻮͋͌􎻮͋͐􎻮͋͑􎻮͋͒􎻮͋͗􎻮͋͛􎻮͋ͣ􎻮͋ͤ􎻮͋ͥ􎻮͋ͦ􎻮͋ͧ􎻮͋ͨ􎻮͋ͩ􎻮͋ͪ􎻮͋ͫ􎻮͋ͬ􎻮͋ͭ􎻮͋ͮ􎻮͋ͯ􎻮͋҃􎻮͋҄􎻮͋҅􎻮͋҆􎻮͋҇􎻮͋֒􎻮͋֓􎻮͋֔􎻮͋֕􎻮͋֗􎻮͋֘􎻮͋֙􎻮͋֜􎻮͋֝􎻮͋֞􎻮͋֟􎻮͋֠􎻮͋֡􎻮͋֨􎻮͋֩􎻮͋֫􎻮͋֬􎻮͋֯􎻮͋ׄ│

                                                                  ╭─ Keys ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
                                                                  │                                                                  │
                                                                  │  → l space pgdn      next step / slide                           │
                                                                  │  ← h pgup            previous                                    │
                                                                  │  ] [                 next / previous slide (skip steps)          │
                                                                  │  g G                 first / last slide                          │
                                                                  │  12g  12⏎            jump to slide 12                            │
                                                                  │  r                   replay this slide                           │
                                                                  │  b .                 black screen (again to resume)              │
                                                                  │  w ,                 white screen (again to resume)              │
                                                                  │  t  T                start or pause the timer / reset it         │
                                                                  │  q                   quit                                        │
                                                                  ╰─ ? or esc closes · deck keys still work ─────────────────────────╯
